## Products Offered

### 1. Welded Bar Grating
Steel grating manufactured by electrically resistance-welding (forge-welding) cross bars to bearing bars at every intersection. Most common type worldwide (~70% of industrial grating).

- **Common designations:** G305/30/100, G325/30/100 (GB YB/T 4001); 19-W-4, 15-W-4, 19-W-2 (ANSI/NAAMM MBG 531)
- **Bearing bar depths:** 20 mm to 65 mm standard, up to 100 mm heavy-duty
- **Open area:** 70-85%
- **Materials:** Carbon steel (hot-dip galvanized), stainless steel 304/316L, aluminum
- **Applications:** Industrial platforms, walkways, mezzanine floors, trench covers
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/welded-bar-grating/

### 2. Press-Locked Bar Grating
Cross bars hydraulically pressed into pre-punched slots — smooth, flush surface, no welding.

- **Advantages:** No weld marks, clean appearance, suitable for architectural use
- **Cost:** 15-30% more than welded grating
- **Applications:** Facades, ceilings, sunscreens, cleanrooms, public walkways
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/press-locked-bar-grating/

### 3. Serrated Bar Grating
Notched/serrated bearing bar tops for enhanced anti-slip performance.

- **Slip resistance:** 25-50% more friction than smooth bearing bars
- **Applications:** Offshore platforms, outdoor walkways, food processing, loading docks
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/serrated-bar-grating/

### 4. Close-Mesh Bar Grating
Narrower bar spacing creates smaller openings to prevent objects falling through.

- **Typical openings:** < 25 mm x 100 mm; ball-proof models < 20 mm x 40 mm
- **High-heel safe:** When openings < 18 mm x 18 mm
- **Applications:** Near rotating equipment, transit platforms, public walkways
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/close-mesh-bar-grating/

### 5. Heavy-Duty Bar Grating
Thicker bearing bars (40-65 mm+) for concentrated point loads from vehicles and equipment.

- **Load capacity:** 10 kN to 50+ kN concentrated load
- **Applications:** Vehicle crossings, forklift aisles, mining, power plant turbine halls
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/heavy-duty-welded-bar-grating/

### 6. Composite Steel Grating
Checker plate bonded to bar grating top surface. 100% coverage, zero open area.

- **Applications:** Above sensitive equipment, electrical rooms, food processing
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/composite-steel-grating/

### 7. Ball-Proof Grating
Mesh openings small enough to prevent a 35 mm sphere from passing through.

- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/bar-grating/ball-proof-grating/

### 8. FRP Grating (Fiberglass Reinforced Polymer)
Non-metallic grating: glass fiber rovings in thermosetting resin. Bi-directional strength.

- **Weight:** 30-40% lighter than steel
- **Corrosion:** Immune to most acids, alkalis, saltwater
- **Resin types:** Polyester (general), vinyl ester (chemical), phenolic (fire)
- **Types:** Molded FRP, chemical-resistant FRP, anti-slip FRP, mini-mesh FRP
- **Applications:** Chemical plants, water treatment, marine, battery rooms, pharmaceutical
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/frp-grating/molded-frp-grating/

### 9. Stair Treads
Pre-fabricated stair treads with integrated nosing.

- **Types:** Welded, serrated (anti-slip), bolted, custom fabricated
- **Standard widths:** 245 mm, 270 mm, 305 mm
- **Lengths:** 600 mm to 1500 mm
- **Materials:** Galvanized steel, stainless steel, aluminum
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/stair-treads/

### 10. Trench Covers
Grating panels for drainage trenches and cable trenches.

- **Types:** Standard (pedestrian, up to 5 kN), heavy-duty (vehicles, 50-400+ kN), drainage channel covers
- **Options:** Hinged, bolt-down, recessed handles, angle-frame locking
- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/trench-covers/

### 11. Accessories
Saddle clips, hold-down clips, panel joining clips, banding bars, toe plates.

- **URL:** https://wibergmetal.com/products/accessories/

## Material and Finish Options

| Material | Finish | Typical Use |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| Carbon steel | Hot-dip galvanized (ASTM A123 / ISO 1461) | 80%+ of installations; 20-50 year outdoor life |
| Stainless 304 | Mill finish or electropolished | Food processing, pharmaceutical, architectural |
| Stainless 316L | Mill finish | Chemical plants, marine, high-chloride environments |
| Aluminum | Mill finish or anodized | Offshore helidecks, lightweight architectural |
| Carbon steel | Untreated (mill finish) | Indoor/dry environments, site-applied coating |
| Carbon steel | Sherardized | Small components, uniform zinc in tight geometries |
| Carbon steel | Painted / powder-coated | Color-coded safety, architectural, indoor |

## Standards and Certifications

- **ANSI/NAAMM MBG 531** — USA bar grating designations and specifications
- **GB YB/T 4001** — Chinese national standard for steel grating
- **EN ISO 24637** — European pressed and welded grating standard
- **ASTM A1053** — Welded steel bar grating specification
- **BS EN 1090** — CE marking for steel structures (EU)
- **ASTM A123 / ISO 1461** — Hot-dip galvanizing
- **NORSOK** — Norwegian offshore standards (upon request)

## Industries Served

1. **Oil & Gas** — Offshore platforms, onshore refineries, pipeline supports
2. **Power Plants** — Turbine halls, boiler platforms, coal handling

4. **Water Treatment** — Walkways, filter access, chlorination areas
5. **Marine & Offshore** — Helidecks, companionways, cargo decks
6. **Industrial Manufacturing** — Mezzanines, equipment platforms
7. **Warehousing & Logistics** — Rack-supported platforms, loading docks
8. **Transportation Infrastructure** — Bridges, transit platforms, tunnels
9. **Data Centers** — Raised floor airflow panels
10. **Renewable Energy** — Solar farm platforms, wind turbine bases

4. Wiberg Metal provides quotation, technical review, and production timeline
